# spectrocloud_registry_pack (Data Source)

Data source for looking up a Spectro pack registry by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Looks up a Spectro pack registry by name.
data "spectrocloud_registry_pack" "my_pack" {
  # Required lookup key.
  name = "my-pack"
}

# Computed.
output "registry_pack_id" {
  value = data.spectrocloud_registry_pack.my_pack.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the pack registry to look up.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
